AAO Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 35 s. 2023 May 05, 2023 ATTY. ARIS L. GULAPA Founding Partner Gulapa Law Unit 8, 25th Floor Exquadra Tower Exchange Road cor. Jade Drive Ortigas Center, Pasig City Dear Atty. Gulapa: This refers to your letter dated November 17, 2022 requesting this Department's legal opinion on the following Resolutions: l. Resolution No. 06, Series of 2020, entitled "A Resolution Declaring Ms. Marie Suzette Chan Good and Mr. Albert Luther Good as Persona Non Grata in the Province of Camiguin" issued by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Camiguin on February 12, 2020; and 2. Resolution No. 2020-01-13, entitled, "A Resolution Declaring Mrs. Marie Suzette Chan Good and Mr. Albert Luther Good as Persona Non-Grata in the Municipality of Mambajao, Camiguin Province" issued by the Sangguniang Bayan of Mambajao, Camiguin on January 21, 2022 (collectively referred to as the "Camiguin Resolutions"). per your letter and the attached Resolutions, hereunder are the pertinent factual antecedents, to wit: • On May 2, 2019, the Municipal Health Office issued a Notice of Violation to Bahay Bakasyunan sa Camiguin (BBC)—an establishment owned by the spouses Good—and revoked the BBC's business permit, citing the resort's violations of Municipal Ordinance No. 2013-04A (The Revised Ecological Waste Management Ordinance of the Municipality of Mambajao). Subsequently, the Municipal Mayor of Mambajao duly issued a Closure Order against Bahay Bakasyunqn sa Camiguin (BBC) and revoked the BBC's business permit. On May 8, 2019, the BBC filed a case for prohibition with a Prayer of Writ of Preliminary Injunction against the Municipal Mayor of Mambajao, praying for an ex-parte Temporary Restraining Order and/or status quo ante order before notice and hearing. Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

On January 17, 2020, the Regional Trial Court (RTC) of Camiguin, Branch 28, issued a Resolution dismissing the Petition for Prohibition and lifting the Writ of Prohibitory Injunction. Pursuant to the R TC's Resolution, Municipal Mayor Jurdin Jesus M. Romualdo ordered the implementation of the Closure Order. Allegedly, due to resistance to the implementation of the Closure Order, the Sangguniang Bayan declared Suzette and Albert persona non grata in the Municipality of Mambajao. Ostensibly, the service of the closure order was conducted in a somber manner and in accordance with due process, it was duly served by authorized officials and personnel of the local government unit. Accordingly, the acts of arrogance, rudeness, serious defiance of a lawful order, and undermining the authority of the persons who served the Closure Order and the installation of the Notice of Closure Order for the information and protection of the public cannot be ignored lightly by the Sangguniang Bayan of Mambajao. It is alleged that the acts of Ms. Suzette Good bespeaks of her arrogance, utmost disrespect, and persistent defiance of the legal and official order. The Sangguniang Panlalawigan, in its Resolution No. 06, Series of 2020, deems it appropriate and justified to declare both Suzette Chan Good and Albert Luther Good as persona non grata throughout the Province of Camiguin for their brazen acts against the duly authorized officials and personnel of the Municipality of Mambajao during the service of the Closure Order. It is your view, citing pertinent legal opinions issued by this Department, that the foregoing Resolutions cannot prevent Sps. Good from entering or exiting Camiguin. You are, nevertheless, seeking clarity and confirmation from this Department to ascertain that your clients are able to enter and exit the Municipality of Mambajao, Camiguin, and the entire province of Camiguin. Hence your query, i.e., whether the subject Resolutions have the effect of preventing the Sps. Good from entering the Municipality of Mambajao, Camiguin, and the entire province of Camiguin. This Department has, time and again, opined that a sangguniang resolution is not a law but a mere expression of sentiment or merely the form in which the legislative body expresses its sentiment. On that score, a sangguniang resolution declaring individuals as persona non grata is merely an expression or declaration of the sentiments or opinions of the August Body. Accordingly, the subject resolutions in question appear to have no legal bearing. In DILG Legal Opinion No. 30, Series of 2020, dated February 7, 2020, we opined therein that while local sanggunian may pass a resolution declaring its sentiment— such as declaring certain individuals as persona non grata—the same must be done within the bounds of law. To put it succinctly, entry is not prohibited. Premises considered, this Department opines that the Resolutions in question do not have the effect of preventing Sps. Good from entering the Municipality of Mambajao, Camiguin, or the Province of Camiguin for that matter. Page 2 of 2

This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, Byt A hority of the Sec tary: ATTY V TOR R. LLAMAS cretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs nd OU LA/JVULLLS-LRALLD/jam cc DIR. WILHELM M.
